$comment: Machine-readable record of what this repository vendors from upstream, and of the boundary
scripts/verify-upstream.sh enforces. One entry per git subtree under crafts/. Update an
entry's `base` (and `lastSyncedUpstream`) every time scripts/fetch-upstream.sh lands a new
upstream commit; the same commit must then appear in docs/upstream-sources.toml and
UPSTREAM_NOTICES.md, and the script fails while the three disagree.

modelNote: Not a fork of any one project. Redrob Canvas's own history begins as a GPL-3.0 Qt editor;
that shell and every Krita/GIMP/GEGL/Graphite-derived file were removed in d4854f2, and the
four ArtCraft editors arrived as `git subtree add --squash` merges, each with a `Squashed
'crafts/<name>/' content from commit <sha>` commit that names the upstream commit. So every
subtree HAS a merge base and upstream work is taken with `git subtree pull --squash`, as a
merge commit, never a squash into a working branch.

excludedReason: Every upstream is MIT OR Apache-2.0 throughout, so no directory is excluded for licence reasons. docs/brand/ under each editor holds the ArtCraft name, wordmark and logos, which upstream's NOTICE marks as trademarks outside the open-source licence; they stay in the tree because the subtree carries them, and nothing in Redrob Canvas may reference, display or package a file under these prefixes.

attribution.why: Apache-2.0 section 4(d) requires upstream's NOTICE content to travel with every distribution, and MIT requires the copyright notice to be retained; NOTICE reproduces each upstream NOTICE verbatim beneath ours.
The one-page statement of who holds what, in both languages' READMEs by reference; it must keep naming both holders.
